description: This Java source file contains a JUnit test class for the WhoamiRoute endpoint in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests the behavior of the route that handles '/whoami' requests, verifying that the route responds correctly with the appropriate user information. The class sets up the necessary test environment, including mock authorization context and headers, and contains a test method 'forwardsWhoamiCommand' that performs an HTTP GET request and asserts the expected response.

classes.name: WhoamiRouteTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the WhoamiRoute endpoint, including setup of test context, headers, and a test case that validates proper response to a '/whoami' GET request.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an ActorSystem, setting up authorization headers, and building the route to test.

methods.name: forwardsWhoamiCommand
methods.description: Test method that executes a GET request to '/whoami' and asserts that the response has status 200 OK and the expected entity content.

methods.name: getAuthContextWithPrefixedSubjectsFromHeaders
methods.description: Helper method that extracts and constructs an AuthorizationContext object from DittoHeaders.
